input_boundary: Requires an unchanged DEPS-populated upstream checkout, installed Linux x64/IA32 sysroots and pinned host Python package. Git revisions/dirty checks cover tracked source; host runtime and Clang resource payloads are individually hashed. Package sysroots remain prepared checkout prerequisites, not files redistributed by GTOS.

zlib_qualification.scope: 真实 zlib 解码与 FileStore 提交后只读缓存刷新工作包；完整 V8/浏览器及成功压缩未验收

ctype_scope: Pinned C/ASCII case conversion, including EOF and unchanged high bytes; no additional locale support
native_standard_stream_scope: Real private static FILE objects: stdout/stderr use GTOS_SYS_WRITE, stdin read explicitly ENOSYS, console seek ESPIPE; regular-file freopen and close lifetime preserved. No general console-input/POSIX descriptor table claim. Console fileno explicitly ENOSYS because no native descriptor service exists; redirected files return their real opaque positive handle.
native_time_format_scope: Pinned unmodified LLVM strftime and time_utils, C locale and non-Linux UTC semantics; formatting of caller tm, not a new RTC/timezone service.
native_chrono_scope: Pinned chrono algorithms; explicit GTOS selection of already implemented CLOCK_MONOTONIC/REALTIME clock_gettime, and pinned no-exception system_error termination. No timespec_get success placeholder or global POSIX identity.
native_wide_scope: Actual full29 libc++ wide time and codecvt UTF-8 consumers; minimal explicit pinned converter scalar/shortest-form, error source-pointer and null-source restart adaptations. No locale repertoire expansion or unrelated API matrix.

hdr/types/mbstate_t.h.purpose: Overlay uses the byte-identical pinned GTOS C SDK mbstate_t instead of rejecting host-libc overlay types

native_runtime_error_scope: Only the pinned actual full30 locale runtime_error helper; retain native verbose fatal termination, no exception profile changes or success placeholder
native_scanf_scope: Pinned required sscanf with full float and 80-bit long-double backend; private GTOS CPL3 qualified, public replay pending. No complete V8 or browser qualification.
native_low_level_alloc_scope: Pinned Abseil arena/split/coalesce with actual GTOS data VM backing; IA32 private single-user-task profile. Cold TLS initialization uses real C heap. No async-signal or parallel-thread qualification.
native_sync_scope: Pinned mutex/condition_variable; checked GTOS ABI1 private single-user-task profile, real deadlines and yielding, no cross-thread notification qualification
native_output_scope: Six pinned V8 OS FILE output wrappers and generic printf family; real native SYNC and truncate-open coherence. Private IA32 single-user-task profile only.
native_numeric_scope: Pinned ceilf/ceil/floor/fmod/abs with real shared errno, integer builtins and x86 FP exceptions; private IA32 single-user task only.
native_exit_scope: Real process callback registration, selective/repeated finalize and normal TLS/static/fini/FILE cleanup; private IA32 single-user task only.
native_hash_scope: Pinned IA32 libc++ prime, Murmur2 hash, unsigned sort and unordered containers; private single-user task.
native_float_conversion_scope: Pinned IA32 float/double/80-bit long-double text parsing, magnitude Down correction and affected sscanf regression; private single-user task.
native_nearbyint_scope: Pinned IA32/SSE2 nearbyint; hardware rounding mode read, private single-user task.
native_virtual_abi_scope: pure/deleted real diagnostic and abort; explicit return faults after successful write; exact heap/frames/FP Reap; one-user-task profile
native_fopen_scope: real V8 FOpen through regular-only NativeFiles/FileStore/LittleFS; paths/modes/OOM; actual FILE/heap/frames/FP Reap; one-user-task profile
native_fopen_target: native_output_libc; minimal gtos-file.cc bridge; existing fopen/backend unchanged
native_thread_heap_scope: real allocator metadata lock and Yield; 24 shared contexts and default FOpen regression; no TLS/per-thread errno/V8 thread qualification
native_thread_tls_scope: real per-thread emutls, external errno and normal cleanup; 74 contexts and default FOpen regression; other shared services and V8 Thread pending
native_v8_thread_scope: real Thread/Semaphore and generation-isolated key;76contexts;full45 now timezone first;whole browser pending
native_v8_platform_core_scope: UTC-only cache, real bounded formatting, fixed scheduling;76contexts;full46 isspace first;whole browser pending
native_text_integer_scope: unchanged pinned LLVM classification and signed integer parsing;76contexts;full47 SetDataReadOnly first;whole browser pending
